# function: bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_version

Builds the ARN for `bedrock` `automated-reasoning-policy-version`:

```
arn:${Partition}:bedrock:${Region}:${Account}:automated-reasoning-policy/${AutomatedReasoningPolicyId}:${AutomatedReasoningPolicyVersion}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:bedrock:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:automated-reasoning-policy/automated-reasoning-policy-id:automated-reasoning-policy-version
output "bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_version" {
  value = provider::arn::bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_version("automated-reasoning-policy-id", "automated-reasoning-policy-version")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
bedrock_automated_reasoning_policy_version(automated_reasoning_policy_id string, automated_reasoning_policy_version string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `automated_reasoning_policy_id` (String) Value for `${AutomatedReasoningPolicyId}` in the ARN template.
1. `automated_reasoning_policy_version` (String) Value for `${AutomatedReasoningPolicyVersion}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
